title: Exact Rust leaf and transposition efficiency
claim: Avoiding unused leaf work and cache hashing reduces fixed-depth CPU cost without changing any value bits; cache scope and depth expose a measurable memory/work frontier.
mechanism: Guard zero-readiness supporter gathering, bypass hashing below table depth, and compare private versus optimistic full-key shared memoization.
falsificationCriteria: Any value-bit mismatch rejects an optimization; a median speed ratio below 1.03 rejects a default performance change.
